notes: Adversarial verification overturns the run2/executor PROCEDURE-DEFECT verdict. The reprice symptom (SF-BRE-00004 at StampBaseFilter#1) is real and reproducible on both fixtures, but it does not survive the defect gate: (a) the intended branch did not run -- fixtures are Amendment/Amend, not LastTransaction/Renewal, so ItemPricingSource is never hydrated (it is a platform-derived resource, never written by the proc); (b) a properly-routed carry-forward line (Renewal Quote 0Q0WC000003FrlR0AS, QLI NetUnitPrice=218.77, ListPrice=0) prices CompletedWithPricing on the identical active V21, proving the carry-forward path is healthy; (c) the executor's specific mechanism (StampBaseFilter#1 crit5 'NetUnitPrice GreaterThan 0 not null-safe', guard 'NOT applied') is contradicted -- half the live StampBaseFilter instances already carry the NetUnitPrice IsNull guard, and the live error is a missing-RESOURCE error not a null-comparison; (d) both failing QLIs are headless Apex-inserts with null NetUnitPrice -- the METHOD_BRIEF's CRITICAL known-harness artifact => BLOCKED. Per the method's #1 trap and BLOCKED rule, a mismatch on inputs that never reached the intended branch is TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT/BLOCKED, not FAIL. The SC-3441 link is superficial (same StampBaseFilter SF-BRE-00004 string) but SC-3441 concerns Cancel lines excluded from the runtime waterfall; this is an Amend line with unhydrated ItemPricingSource -- different provenance.
verdict_reason: BLOCKED (TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT).
